name: pitcrew
description: Keeps a Claude Code session's context and prompt cache in shape. context-watch (on by default): warns the agent before auto-compaction and snapshots the session at each compaction; can also show its context against the auto-compaction point on every prompt (off by default). cache-watch (per session, on request): wakes an idle session before its one-hour prompt cache expires. Reads the settings PaceLine kept for the same watchers until PitCrew writes its own, in state/pitcrew under $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+ and Python 3.9+.
